bio: I’m an undergraduate student majoring in Communication Engineering. I expect to graduate in June 2027.

My research looks for simple ways to improve how AI models learn and run. I work on multimodal models and image/video generation, and I’m interested in AI infrastructure and reinforcement learning for embodied agents.

publications.title: If You Hear It, Help Find It: Orthogonal Knowledge Distillation for Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Event Localization
publications.abstract: We study open-vocabulary audio-visual event localization when visual and audio teachers differ in reliability. OV-OrthKD places their supervision in separate orthogonal feature paths and uses text prototypes for open-vocabulary transfer.
publications.imageAlt: Audio and visual teachers supervise separate feature paths in OV-OrthKD.

publications.title: OrthKD: Extracting Generalized Clinical Knowledge from Heterogeneous Teachers for Lightweight Deployment
publications.abstract: OrthKD combines decision supervision from a CNN with complementary visual features from a Transformer. Orthogonal projections keep these signals separate as they train a 5.4M-parameter MobileNetV3 student for diabetic retinopathy screening.
publications.imageAlt: A CNN and a Transformer guide a lightweight student through complementary feature paths.

publications.title: Enabling Visual Reasoning in Text-Only LLMs via Symbolic Scene Descriptions
publications.abstract: We convert images into grammar-constrained scene descriptions for text-only LLMs. On a stratified 5,000-image VQAv2 subset, DeepYOLO reaches 42.3% accuracy using 1/2.5 as many prompt tokens as the scene-graph baseline.
publications.imageAlt: The system converts an image into a structured scene description for a text-only language model.

publications.title: CINEMA: Preserving the Rhythm of Image Editing
publications.abstract: Training-free image editing for frozen diffusion/flow models across multi-step, few-step, and one-step inference. A closed-form coupling rule preserves paired-state geometry, with exact composition and minimum-displacement properties for the interaction. Cross-backbone ablations, source-paired assessments, and complete first-edit cost measurements evaluate preservation, instruction completion, and efficiency across five benchmarks.
publications.imageAlt: Examples of image editing with CINEMA and an overview of the paired-state method.
